scope: Independent per-bank client identity/credit/ACK seam. No assigned group1 owner or local cache composition.
roots: One engine root per bank; actual synthesis/CTS required, not assigned.
ordering: Read identity pops only on ordered native response. Write identity pops only on committed done. Queue credit can return before done.
fence: Stop new acceptance; retain owner request until all identities/credits/output and captured input pulses drained and external real path_quiet asserted. path_quiet cannot be inferred from local ACK counts.
address_guard: Bank sector[2:0] equals bank strap; main sector[14:13] equals slice strap; mirror sector[14:13] must be zero. Invalid requests never enter native lane and latch fault.
negative_control: MUT_EARLY_RELEASE ignores committed write debt and external path_quiet during fence; must fail owner lifetime test.
